name: Slice Plane Rendering via Shader Interception
aliases: Slice Planes Rendering via Shader Interception
definition: A technique to render orthogonal slice planes inside a 3D volume by intercepting the volume rendering draw call, swapping the shader to a dedicated slice shader, and disabling depth testing to ensure visibility.
summary: Slice Plane Rendering via Shader Interception renders orthogonal slice planes inside a 3D volume by intercepting the draw call, swapping shaders, and disabling depth testing to avoid conflicts.
